findings.finding: 13 unit tests cover: h2 parsing, h3 sub-splitting, empty input, no-header input, token counting, preamble handling, markdown generation, JSON sidecar generation, ZIP artifact creation, h2/h3 confusion regression. Good coverage of parsing edge cases.
Integration test for seed::run() with real McpState is not included. This is expected since it requires full infrastructure (embedder, store, keypair). The smoke verification step covers this path.

summary: Test coverage is adequate. 13 unit tests cover all pure functions (parsing, splitting, artifact generation). The h2/h3 regression test was added after the bug was found. All tests pass.
